name: jirav2
label: Jira v2
description: Create, update, search and transition Jira Cloud issues, and work with Jira Service Management requests and queues. Supports scoped API tokens, tests every action offline, and ships a generic API call for anything not covered.

fields.name: server_url
fields.title: Server URL
fields.description: Your Jira Cloud site, for example https://yourcompany.atlassian.net. For a scoped API token either tick "Scoped API Token" below, or enter https://api.atlassian.com/ex/jira/<cloudId> here.
fields.tooltip: Your Jira Cloud site, for example https://yourcompany.atlassian.net. For a scoped API token either tick "Scoped API Token" below, or enter https://api.atlassian.com/ex/jira/<cloudId> here.

fields.name: auth_type
fields.title: Authentication
fields.description: Basic: the Atlassian account email as Username and an API token as API Token. Bearer: an OAuth 2.0 access token, sent as-is; Username is ignored.
fields.tooltip: Basic: the Atlassian account email as Username and an API token as API Token. Bearer: an OAuth 2.0 access token, sent as-is; Username is ignored.

Basic (Email + API Token).name: username
Basic (Email + API Token).title: Username
Basic (Email + API Token).description: The Atlassian account email address the API token was created under (not the token name). Not used for Bearer authentication.
Basic (Email + API Token).tooltip: The Atlassian account email address the API token was created under (not the token name). Not used for Bearer authentication.

fields.name: token
fields.title: API Token
fields.description: The API token (Basic) or access token (Bearer).
fields.tooltip: The API token (Basic) or access token (Bearer).

fields.name: scoped
fields.title: Scoped API Token
fields.description: Tick this when the token was created with scopes. Requests are then routed through https://api.atlassian.com/ex/jira/<cloudId>, which is the only place Atlassian accepts a scoped token. An unrestricted token does not need it.
fields.tooltip: Tick this when the token was created with scopes. Requests are then routed through https://api.atlassian.com/ex/jira/<cloudId>, which is the only place Atlassian accepts a scoped token. An unrestricted token does not need it.

fields.name: cloud_id
fields.title: Cloud ID
fields.description: (Optional) The site's cloud id, used only with "Scoped API Token". Left empty, it is looked up from <Server URL>/_edge/tenant_info.
fields.tooltip: (Optional) The site's cloud id, used only with "Scoped API Token". Left empty, it is looked up from <Server URL>/_edge/tenant_info.

fields.name: timeout
fields.title: Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Seconds to wait for each request. Defaults to 30.
fields.tooltip: Seconds to wait for each request. Defaults to 30.

fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set to True.
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set to True.

operations.title: Create Ticket
operations.description: Creates an issue. Give the issue type by name or by id. Anything else the project requires (a custom field, a JSM request type, a reporter) goes in Other Fields.

operations.title: Get Project Options
operations.description: Populates project dropdowns: every project the account can browse, as Name (KEY) / key pairs.

operations.title: Get Issue Type Options
operations.description: Populates issue type dropdowns with the chosen project's issue type names (the whole site's when no project is chosen).

operations.title: Get Issue Type ID Options
operations.description: Populates issue type id dropdowns as Name [id] / id pairs, for the chosen project when one is set.

operations.title: Get Link Type Options
operations.description: Populates link type dropdowns with the issue link type names.

operations.title: Get User Options
operations.description: Populates assignee dropdowns with the active people on the site, as Name (email) / account id.

operations.title: Get Service Desk Options
operations.description: Populates service desk dropdowns as Project (KEY) / service desk id.

operations.title: Get Request Type Options
operations.description: Populates request type dropdowns for the chosen service desk. Empty until Service Desk is set.

operations.title: Get Queue Options
operations.description: Populates queue dropdowns for the chosen service desk. Empty until Service Desk is set.

operations.title: Get Transition Options
operations.description: Populates status dropdowns with what the chosen issue can move to now. Empty until Issue Key is set.

operations.title: Get Transition ID Options
operations.description: Populates transition id dropdowns for the chosen issue. Empty until Issue Key is set.
